name: ascot-lsp
description: ascot as an LSP server for InterSystems ObjectScript

iris.title: IRIS
iris.description: Where classes, routines and includes outside the workspace are resolved: an IRIS Community release such as 2026.2, an instance as http://user:password@host:port, a declaration file written by `ascot declare`, or `none`. Leave empty for the newest release ascot knows.

iris_namespace.title: IRIS namespace
iris_namespace.description: The namespace of the instance or declaration file. Leave empty for %SYS.

style.title: Style file
style.description: A JSON file of style rules, as documented in STYLE.md. Leave empty to check no style.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics filter
diagnostics.description: Which codes are reported, and at what severity: VERB:TARGETS values separated by spaces, such as `off:hint on:A5579`. Leave empty for every code at its own severity.
